notes: Stage B answers yes to a space and no to walking on it: there is real geometry - stage, backdrop screen, rig - but the answers lock the camera on the stage and put the player on GUI controls, so this is set-display and SET rather than venue-stage, and it is emphatically not P5 because the set is the deliverable. Entertainment leads because the sentence is about a music performance, with Simulation named second for the earn-and-equip tapping loop; none of Simulation's options apply, since its hub, gates and training stations are all ground a player would have to stand on. Kept the Display Piece preset's landmark-focal for the stage-and-screen assembly and zone-graphics for the lasers, fireworks and VFX clusters that get toggled per show, dropped vignette-photo because a locked camera leaves no separate screenshot spots, and added spawn-first-reveal for the opening framing plus npc-population for the punk rock star, who is the named figure the whole build faces. Decided without a user: stage and immediate frontage only, no crowd floor or back-of-house, and the sound-wave energy meter is UI with no geometry to place.
